chunks.title: Profile and overview
chunks.text: Jayce Nhan Parabellum (he/him) is an AI Software Engineer based in Denver, Colorado. Jayce builds LLM applications that run on local or managed models, with agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over vector databases, Docker packaging, and CI evaluation gates that stop bad releases. Jayce is a United States Armed Forces veteran (U.S. Marine Corps, D.C. Air National Guard, and U.S. Air Force Reserve) and is Top Secret clearance eligible.

chunks.title: Profile and overview
chunks.text: Jayce's engineering approach comes from the flight line, where a 7-level signs for every job against technical data before an aircraft flies: nothing leaves the shop without a sign-off. Jayce builds AI systems the same way, measured, traceable and honest about what they don't know, around three principles. Ground every answer: retrieval over the real source material (regulations, protocols, patient records) with citations required, and the system says so when the sources don't cover a question instead of guessing; the TTB label verification tool and the clinical co-pilot work this way. Gate every release: versioned prompts, golden datasets, regression replay and eval gates in CI, so a change ships when the evals say so, not when the demo looks good; the TTB tool gated every release on 446 automated tests plus RAG and agent-behavior evals, and at Teos every change goes through required code review, tests and deployment checks. Secure by default: encryption at rest, record-level access control, audit logs, secret scanning in the build and STIG-hardened hosts, a habit from six years of NIST and RMF work on federal cloud systems.

chunks.title: Profile and overview
chunks.text: Jayce is interested in AI engineer, applied AI, and AI platform roles, especially ones that combine LLM applications with secure cloud infrastructure, regulated environments (healthcare, government, finance), and production evaluation. Jayce is open to three kinds of work: freelance or contract projects, full-time corporate roles, and consulting engagements. For specifics about availability, compensation, or relocation, contact Jayce directly.

chunks.section: How Jayce works with an AI coding agent
chunks.text: Jayce uses an AI coding agent inside the team's process rather than around it. After a few early stacked pull requests were merged before approval and had to be reverted and redone, the team made code review required on every pull request and added a rule that every pull request includes screenshots of passing tests and the running UI. Before starting a ticket Jayce checks whether anyone else is assigned to it or has branches touching the same files, and keeps each change within what the ticket describes.

chunks.title: Gauntlet AI Fellowship - AI Engineer, Challenger, Cohort 4 (Apr - Aug 2026)
chunks.text: Stack: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, Claude and Ollama, Postgres, Docker, GitHub Actions. Built and deployed an AI compliance tool that checks alcohol beverage labels against 27 CFR (TTB regulations) and returns PASS/FLAG verdicts. Scored 100% correct decisions on a 24-case eval set with a 211 ms worst-case response, and hands unreadable labels to a human reviewer instead of guessing. The LangGraph assistant runs on Claude in the cloud or Ollama locally, with human confirmation on every write and a hash-chained audit log in Postgres. It uses citation-grounded RAG over 27 CFR with BM25 and BGE embeddings combined by reciprocal rank fusion, and refuses when the regulations don't cover the question. Every release was gated on 446 automated tests, a RAG eval and a replayed agent-behavior eval in GitHub Actions. Jayce fixed 21 CVEs and added upload limits and security headers before launch. Code: github.com/jayceparabellum/TTB_AI_Label_Verification_Tool

chunks.text: github.com/jayceparabellum/secure-cicd-demo is a small Python FastAPI app with a browser UI that audits HTTP security response headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy) and returns a 0-100 score with findings. chunks.title: About this AI assistant
chunks.text: This site's assistant is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that Jayce built to showcase his AI engineering. The knowledge base is a set of curated markdown files about Jayce's career, chunked by section. For each question, a Cloudflare Worker (1) rewrites follow-up questions into standalone search queries with Llama 3.1 8B, (2) runs hybrid retrieval: BM25 keyword search plus dense vector search with BGE embeddings on Cloudflare Workers AI, (3) merges both rankings with reciprocal rank fusion, (4) reranks the candidates with a BGE cross-encoder reranker, and (5) streams a grounded answer from Meta's Llama 3.3 70B model, running on Cloudflare Workers AI, that cites its sources and declines when the knowledge base doesn't cover the question. Rate limiting, input limits, an origin allowlist, prompt-injection rules and signed conversation history protect the endpoint, and everything runs on Cloudflare's free tier with no third-party API keys. The code is public in the site's GitHub repository under chat-worker/.

chunks.title: About this AI assistant
chunks.text: The assistant only answers questions about Jayce Nhan Parabellum's career, skills, projects, service and public interests. It will not share private details such as phone number, home address, or credential numbers, it won't speculate about salary expectations, and it doesn't make up facts that aren't in its sources.

chunks.title: About this AI assistant
chunks.text: The chat has a Contact Jayce form for hiring inquiries. Visitors choose freelance or contract work, a full-time corporate role, or consulting, add their name, email, optional company and a message, and can include the chat so far for context. The Worker emails it straight to Jayce's inbox through the FormSubmit relay, with the visitor's address set as the reply-to, so Jayce answers by email. The form is rate-limited and filters spam bots. If it is ever unavailable, visitors can email jayce.n.parabellum@gmail.com.
